# Monocypher 4.0.3 (vendored)

Upstream: https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher, tag 4.0.3, commit ab2b16dd619ad5f6979a4fbe69cfa324a6fcc35f.
Files copied unchanged: `src/monocypher.c/.h`, `src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.c/.h`, `LICENCE.md`.
Licence: dual 2-clause BSD / CC0 (LICENCE.md). Used for Ed25519 signature checks of licence files (`core/src/license.cpp`).
The files compile as C and as C++ (g++ treats `.c` as C++; the headers give C linkage either way).
